note: NLB's Mastercard is a deferred-payment card: what's bought is paid on the 8th, 18th or 28th of the month, so nothing is carried. Its membership fee for a customer without an NLB package, paid by direct debit, is 28 euros a year from 1 August 2026 (26 before).

sources.title: NLB, Kreditne kartice Mastercard
sources.said: Kupite danes, plačajte jutri (8., 18. ali 28. v mesecu)

sources.title: NLB, Napovednik sprememb v NLB Tarifi za prebivalstvo s 1. 8. 2026
sources.said: Napovednik sprememb s 1. 8. 2026 ... 6.1. Članarina za kartice z odloženim plačilom in dodatne kartice NLB Karanta, NLB Mastercard, NLB Visa 6.1.3. Plačevanje prek direktne bremenitve - za stranke, ki niso imetniki paketa 26,00 28,00 EUR letno
